non_exclusions: Adjacent GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and open-weight checkpoints remain eligible when their exact release identity is not covered above.
Gemini 2.5 Flash remains eligible: the secondary APE cohort covered Gemini 2.0 Flash and the Gemini 2.5 Pro line, not the 2.5 Flash release.
Secondary MASK, DisElect, InfoOpsBench, agentic-influence, persuasion-effect, or human-subject results do not exclude a checkpoint from APE because they measure different constructs.
The prior six-topic project APE construction canary is instrumentation evidence, not a 120-topic benchmark result, and does not exclude either DeepSeek V4 Flash checkpoint.
Service tiers and dated checkpoints are treated as distinct only when OpenRouter exposes a stable canonical identity and the secondary evidence does not already cover that release.
rule: Exclude a served model release from the primary APE-120 wave when author-reported or independently reported APE evidence already covers that exact release identity. Where the secondary work used a mutable release alias and did not disclose the resolved snapshot, conservatively exclude the currently served dated snapshots of that same named release rather than claim a new checkpoint.
